LeftTransalveolar_cmH2O.timeSemantics: Explicit same-side instantaneous alveolar-minus-pleural distending pressure, not Pulse GetTranspulmonaryPressure which uses airway-opening minus pleural pressure

nativeAccess: Public pulse::Engine::GetController -> CircuitManager -> GetActiveRespiratoryCircuit plus gas compartment/link path identity checks. No protected-member hack or engine fork.
nonAggregation: Never add parent and children. Pleural circuit volumes are mechanical state, not extra alveolar gas. Ambient volume is intentionally infinite (SetupCircuitsAndCompartments.cpp 106-108), not a finite pulmonary recording channel.
timing: Driver phase inherited from baseline; Instantaneous common configuration does not reset native cycle. Breath start algorithm follows actual driver departure, not t modulo 5.
pressureAxis: Use same-side LeftTransalveolar_cmH2O versus leftAlveoli_L for dynamic distension; no bilateral weighting hidden. Use driver_cmH2O versus volume_L only as labelled input-volume. Flow-volume is tidal.
